_rulescope_notes: Created with POST /api/alerting/rule/rulescope-catalog-stale (or rulescope-catalog-stale-<space> per space). Keys starting with _rulescope are removed before sending.

Fires for each catalog scope that ran in the last 7 days but has no successful sync in the last 3 hours. Report modules stop using a catalog older than 2 hours, so this means their results have stopped too.
A scope that never synced at all isn't detected; the Catalog health panel shows that.
name: Rule Catalog: no successful sync in 3 hours

esqlQuery.esql:
FROM rulescope-catalog-syncs
| WHERE kind == "sync"
| EVAL ok_recent = CASE(status == "success" AND @timestamp >= NOW() - 3 hours, 1, 0)
| STATS ok = SUM(ok_recent), last_run = MAX(@timestamp), last_success = MAX(CASE(status == "success", @timestamp, null)) BY scope = rulescope.scope
| WHERE ok == 0
| LIMIT 100
